raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 14
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer asserted “Britannica confirms construction began in 1421” without showing any Britannica result or link to substantiate it. The visible search results only showed Wikipedia and other sites, not Britannica. This introduced an unsupported, conflicting date that misled the process and contradicted earlier credible indications (early 15th century, c. 1400–1403), derailing convergence on the correct construction timeline.
